brain/scripts/verify_auth.py.does: Verifies login/logout/RBAC locators and flows against http://localhost:3000
flows_verified: invalid login stays on /login with no visible error UI (app finding)

discoveries: docs/e2e-test-cases.md Appendix A documents login inputs as data-testid, but the app implements them as plain id attributes with matching string values — no data-testid rendered anywhere on the login page.

Invalid login shows NO visible error/toast/alert; the Sign In button flashes 'Signing in...' then silently reverts to 'Sign In'. Documented app-behavior finding vs. AUTH-E2E-003's expected 'Error message shown'.

Toast text can also appear as a page heading (e.g. 'Welcome back, user!' in dashboard main content), causing Playwright strict-mode violations unless the toast lookup is scoped to the aria-label='Notifications...' region.
